title: Relative Oceanic Nino Index by season

metadata.note: RONI subtracts the tropical-mean SST anomaly from the Nino 3.4 anomaly, on the reasoning that convection responds to the Pacific's warmth RELATIVE to the rest of the tropics rather than to absolute local warmth. As the tropics warm, raw ONI drifts upward for the same relative gradient, so RONI runs cooler than ONI in recent decades. CPC's official El Nino declaration still uses ONI, not RONI. CPC warns real-time RONI values may be revised for up to two months.
